query: WITH matched_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_user.user_id FROM workspace_user INNER JOIN "user" ON workspace_user.user_id = "user".id WHERE workspace_user.workspace_id = $1 AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".username ILIKE '%' || $2::TEXT || '%') AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".first_name ILIKE '%' || $3::TEXT || '%') AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".last_name ILIKE '%' || $4::TEXT || '%')), users_page AS (SELECT user_id FROM matched_users ORDER BY user_id LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6) SELECT users_page.user_id AS "user_id!", role_binding.role_id AS "role_id?", (role_binding.scope_id = role_binding.workspace_id) AS "is_workspace_scope?", role_binding.scope_id AS "scope_id?", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_users) AS "total_count!" FROM users_page LEFT JOIN actor ON actor.user_id = users_page.user_id AND actor.workspace_id = $1 LEFT JOIN role_binding ON role_binding.actor_id = actor.id ORDER BY users_page.user_id, role_binding.role_id;
